question: A storage administrator is managing a NetApp ONTAP 9.17.1 cluster with FlexCache for NAS workloads. There is a new requirement to enable applications to access data on the FlexCache volumes using the S3 protocol. Which step is required to support this configuration? A. Configure user mapping between Active Directory users and S3 users. B. Update the NetApp Console agent. C. Configure mapping between an S3 bucket name and a NAS path. D. Update the ONTAP software release to 9.18.1 or higher.
What is enabled on a NetApp ONTAP SMB share to increase data throughput and fault tolerance for Microsoft SQL Server databases? A. multichannel B. multipath C. igroup D. round-robin

Your NetApp ONTAP cluster has been experiencing intermittent latency issues during peak hours. As an administrator, you want to set up alerting and investigate the root cause. Which NetApp tool can help you monitor performance and configure alerts based on threshold breaches? A. Active IQ Config Advisor B. Active IQ Unified Manager C. ONTAP System Manager D. Active IQ OneCollect
Which feature is enabled by default on newly created storage units after you upgrade an existing cluster to NetApp ONTAP 9.18.1 software? A. QoS policy B. ARP/AI C. SnapMirror D. encryption
Which NetApp ONTAP feature enables replication of objects from one bucket to another bucket on a different cluster? A. CloudMirror B. FlexClone C. SnapVault D. SnapMirror S3

A customer with a NetApp ONTAP based system has experienced a ransomware attack in the past. They need a way to protect critical volume snapshots so that even if an admin account is compromised, the attacker cannot delete or modify those snapshots. Which two ONTAP features protect against snapshot deletion by an administrator account? (Choose two.) A. tamperproof snapshots B. multi-admin verification C. consistency group snapshots D. Autonomous Ransomware Protection

What allows an automatic switchover of a SnapMirror active sync relationship in the event of a site disaster? A. NetApp ONTAP Mediator B. automated unplanned switchover C. NetApp Tiebreaker software D. cluster failover
Which component is required for a NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP deployment in AWS? A. NetApp Console agent B. NetApp ONTAP Cloud Mediator C. NetApp ONTAP Deploy utility D. Acquisition Unit

To reduce the on-site footprint, several NetApp FAS clusters are being consolidated into a newly purchased NetApp AFF cluster. The administrator needs to relocate several NFSv3-only SVMs nondisruptively to the new cluster. Which NetApp solution accomplishes this goal? A. SVM migrate B. NetApp Backup and Recovery C. SnapMirror SVM D. SnapMirror volume

An administrator has four SVMs within their cluster, and corporate policy dictates a need for SVMs to be isolated from each other. Which vserver modify command does the administrator use on each SVM to keep the data separate? A. storage-limit B. aggr-list C. caching-policy D. qos-policy-group

An administrator creates a new FlexCache volume and wants to warm the cache before the client’s initial access. How is this task accomplished? A. Synchronize the origin and cache first. B. Copy the data by using NetApp XCP software. C. Enable block-level invalidation. D. Prepopulate the cache volume.

Which NetApp tool is used for collecting performance, capacity, and hardware metrics from NetApp ONTAP clusters to display in Grafana dashboards? A. ONTAP System Manager B. Prometheus C. NetApp Harvest D. Active IQ Unified Manager

While investigating slow network performance, a storage administrator discovers that port e1a is saturated with traffic, whereas port e1b is underutilized. All ports are in the same broadcast domain. How can the administrator improve network performance without modifying the switching configuration? A. Create VLANs to separate traffic. B. Create a multimode ifgrp with ports e1a and e1b. C. Migrate some LIFs to port e1a. D. Migrate some U Fs to port e1b.

You recently configured a new SVM and enabled jumbo frames (MTU 9000) on NetApp ONTAP software and on the clients. However, some clients are experiencing timeouts or degraded performance when accessing the system. You are using the ping -lif NAME -vserver NAME -destination CLIENTIP -disallow-fragmentation true -packet-size XXX command to test the network path for jumbo frames. What value must you use on the parameter packet-size? A. 1472 B. 8972 C. 9216 D. 9000

You need to provide continuous availability and transparent failover of SAN data between two NetApp ASA r2 systems. Which NetApp feature do you use? A. SnapMirror asynchronous B. SnapMirror active sync C. SnapMirror synchronous D. MetroCluster IP
Which NetApp ONTAP component enables clients to access data when having multiple tenants with overlapping IP addresses? A. interface group B. subnet C. LIF D. IPspace
Which NetApp ONTAP management UI performs drag and drop administrative operations? A. Active IQ Unified Manager B. NetApp Console C. ONTAP System Manager D. ONTAP CLI

Which action is required before reconfiguring an existing NetApp ONTAP LUN to be converted to use the NVMe protocol? A. Unmap the LUN from the igroup. B. Take the LUN offline. C. Take the data LIF offline. D. Take the volume hosting the LUN offline.
